name: (05) Dark Thaumaturgy (Fires of the Inferno) — 3 Advanced — Furnaces of Hell

system.description:
The master of hellfire flings open the furnace doors, engulfing whole ranks of enemies in simultaneous, roaring eruptions of flame.

Spend a Willpower Trait and make a mass challenge against all your intended targets, up to as many as you have permanent Willpower, testing your Mental Traits against their Physical Traits. Anyone you beat suffers the effects of Incinerate, but the initial injury to each is three levels of aggravated damage, and each victim continues to burn for one additional aggravated level per turn until they douse the flames. The fire is supernatural, ignoring mundane protection and armor; range is your line of sight. Retest with Occult.
